exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.precautions: Elbows tucked at your sides and completely still;Upper arms vertical - only forearms move down;Stand tall, shoulders down away from ears;Wrist straight, grip firm
exercises.cues: Elbows tucked at your sides;Push down until arms straight;Control the way back up

exercises.name: DB Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.precautions: Keep your upper arm still and vertical, close to your head;Elbow pointing forward, in line with your body;Only your forearm moves - upper arm does not swing;Stand tall, ribs down, no leaning back
exercises.cues: Elbows pointing forward, still;Lower weight behind head slowly;Straighten arms without flaring elbows

exercises.name: Diamond Push-up
exercises.precautions: Body in one straight line head-to-heels - hips not sagging or piked (unless Pike);Hands under shoulders, fingers spread;Head neutral - look at floor, not forward;Only arms bend - torso stays rigid like a plank
exercises.cues: Body in one straight line;Hands under shoulders;Lower with control, press up

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.precautions: Hands on bench edge behind you, fingers forward;Back close to the bench - hips slide straight down;Elbows point straight back, not out to sides;Lower only until upper arms feel a stretch - stop if shoulders pinch
exercises.cues: Sit on bench, hands at hips;Walk feet out a little;Dip down and press up slowly

exercises.name: DB Triceps Kickback
exercises.precautions: Hinge forward with a flat back, free hand supported;Upper arm horizontal, tucked tight to your side - it never moves;Elbow locked in place - only forearm swings back;Wrist straight, no twisting at the end
exercises.cues: Upper arm parallel to floor;Kick dumbbell straight back;Squeeze triceps, lower slowly

exercises.name: DB Skull Crusher
exercises.precautions: Lying on bench, arms straight up over shoulders;Upper arms completely still and vertical - only forearms bend;Elbows point at ceiling, close together - no flaring;Lower dumbbells beside ears (not to forehead)
exercises.cues: Press dumbbells up over chest;Bend elbows to lower by ears;Straighten arms without moving elbows

exercises.name: Seated Dip Machine
exercises.precautions: Adjust the seat so the dip handles are level with your chest;Keep shoulders down away from your ears the whole set;Torso stays still and upright - only your arms press;Press until arms are nearly straight - do not slam elbows locked
exercises.cues: Shoulders down, chest tall;Press handles down smoothly;Control the way back up

exercises.name: Triceps Extension Machine
exercises.precautions: Back stays against the pad the whole set;Elbows pinned in place - only your forearms move;Press the handles forward until arms are nearly straight - do not lock out hard;Return slowly - do not let the stack slam
exercises.cues: Elbows pinned, back on pad;Press forward to straight arms;Lower slowly with control

stretches.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
stretches.precautions: Keep your upper arm still and vertical, close to your head;Elbow pointing forward, in line with your body;Only your forearm moves - upper arm does not swing
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
